text:
sree: Quick sync idea: introduce a small runtime signal `tenant_budget_score` (0..1) computed per tenant+region to help policies avoid immediate cross-region hedges on short spikes. Need API + rollout plan.

hannah: SGTM. Two big decisions: compute in-process or via sidecar. Sidecar seems safer for rollout.

marco: Sidecar + unix socket for perf. Cache headers at ingress so runtime read is O(1). Protect with signature.

rachel: Agree. Default if missing/stale score = 1 (permissive) and emit an alert. Otherwise we risk accidental throttling.

sree: DSL surface thought: builtin `tenant_budget_score()` reading request meta. Keep it opaque to compiler (runtime-only). Also add `budget_window_seconds` in header for TL semantics.

hannah: Migration: opt-in shadow for 14 days -> collect flip-rate + p99 delta -> small canary -> full rollout. Add feature flag REDWOOD_TENANT_BUDGETS for emergency kill.

marco: Perf guardrails: header lookup + parse <1ms median, <4ms p99. Also test sidecar saturation case (simulate thousands of tenants).

rachel: Telemetry: histogram of scores, per-tenant flip count, percent requests with missing/stale header. Pager if >2% missing for >5m. Dashboards per-region + tenant heatmap.

sree: Security: scorer signs header with rotating keys; runtime verifies signature. Do not accept client-supplied X-Redwood-Budget.

hannah: Edge-case: cross-region request with two scores. Policy should get both (list in header) and recommended merge rule: use min(score) for conservative routing, allow explicit policy override. Document examples.

marco: Tests for compiler: ensure `tenant_budget_score()` can't be constant-folded and remains evaluated at runtime. Add e2e shadow runs and chaos tests where sidecar is killed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: started staging rollout for `feature/tenant-budgets-v1` -> arch-staging (5 hosts) :rocket:

sree: I'll write a short RFC with protocol (header format + unix socket JSON), decay math (exp decay half-life default 10s), and the migration checklist. Rachel, can you draft dashboards? Marco, prototype sidecar shim? Hannah, add compiler guards?
rachel: On it. I'll sketch dashboards and alert thresholds.

marco: prototyping today. I'll push a small shim that returns `{tenant,region,score,window_seconds,version}` over unix socket.

sree: Great. We'll reconvene after RFC PR. Thanks all.
